## File: universe.ui-framework.yaml
## Type: application UI framework config
## Purpose: Defines the default UI framework for the Universe application,
## including pane layout and project/tenant override file paths.

ui_interface:
  ui_framework: multi_pane

  overrides:
    project: project/ui/multi_pane.override.yaml
    tenant: tenant/ui/multi_pane.override.yaml

  panes:
    - id: results_list
      role: list
      coordinates:
        x: 0
        y: 0
        width: 40
        height: 100
      border_pattern: default
      colour_scheme: default
      carousel:
        enabled: false

    - id: preview
      role: preview
      coordinates:
        x: 40
        y: 0
        width: 35
        height: 100
      border_pattern: default
      colour_scheme: default
      carousel:
        enabled: false

    - id: version_carousel
      role: list
      coordinates:
        x: 75
        y: 0
        width: 25
        height: 60
      border_pattern: default
      colour_scheme: default
      carousel:
        enabled: true
        active_index: 0
        navigation:
          wrap: true
          jump: true
          refresh: true

    - id: diff_panel
      role: diff_right
      coordinates:
        x: 75
        y: 60
        width: 25
        height: 40
      border_pattern: default
      colour_scheme: default
      carousel:
        enabled: false

  diff_view:
    synchronized_navigation: true
    active_index: 0
    pairs: []
